name: DashClaw Governance
description: Policy enforcement, human-in-the-loop approval, and decision recording for every OpenClaw tool call. Powered by DashClaw.

configSchema.description: Configure the DashClaw connection via any of three shapes: (a) canonical plugin-config keys `dashclawUrl` + `dashclawApiKey` (+ optional `agentId`); (b) SDK-style aliases `baseUrl` + `apiKey`; (c) environment variables `DASHCLAW_BASE_URL` (or legacy `DASHCLAW_URL`) + `DASHCLAW_API_KEY` (+ optional `DASHCLAW_AGENT_ID`) set before the gateway starts. Precedence is plugin config > env. No field is strictly required in this schema — env vars alone are sufficient.

dashclawUrl.description: URL of your DashClaw instance (e.g. https://my-dashclaw.vercel.app). Optional if DASHCLAW_BASE_URL / DASHCLAW_URL env var is set, or if baseUrl is provided.

dashclawApiKey.description: DashClaw API key (starts with oc_live_). Optional if DASHCLAW_API_KEY env var is set, or if apiKey is provided.

baseUrl.description: SDK-style alias for dashclawUrl. Use whichever you prefer.

apiKey.description: SDK-style alias for dashclawApiKey. Use whichever you prefer.

defaultModel.description: Fallback model id (e.g. 'openai-codex/gpt-5.4') used when llm_output events fire without a model field. Without this, server-side cost estimation cannot price the turn and stores cost_estimate = 0. Also settable via DASHCLAW_DEFAULT_MODEL env var.

failClosed.description: If true, block tool calls when DashClaw is unreachable. If false, allow them to proceed.

riskScoreDefault.description: Default risk score for tool calls that don't have a specific mapping

highRiskTools.description: Tool names that should always get risk_score 80+ (e.g. bash, exec, deploy)

x402Enabled.description: Detect x402 capability payments (e.g. agentcash) and govern + record them as DashClaw x402 purchases so they appear on the Spend surfaces. Gate runs before the payment; settled spend is recorded after.

x402CommandPatterns.description: Case-insensitive regexes matched against any tool's command (bash/exec, Codex shell_command, or a wrapper script) to identify an x402 PAYMENT. The default matches both the agentcash `fetch` CLI and wrappers like .../agentcash/fetch-json.mjs. Free quote commands like `agentcash check` are not matched.

x402ToolNames.description: Dedicated tool names (e.g. an agentcash MCP tool) that are themselves x402 payments. Matched in addition to x402CommandPatterns; the URL/amount are read from the tool params.

x402EstimatedCostUsd.description: Fallback per-purchase USD estimate used for the pre-payment guard when neither --max-amount nor an amount param is present. Lets x402_spend_limit policies evaluate before the payment runs.

x402AutoRegisterProviders.description: Look up or create an x402 provider by the endpoint origin (best-effort) so /spend/x402 groups purchases by provider. Falls back to a free-text provider when lookup fails; never blocks recording.

x402Debug.description: Log x402 detection + recording breadcrumbs to the gateway console (gate, record, receipt parse). Also enabled by env DASHCLAW_X402_DEBUG=1. Use to confirm whether the plugin sees and parses a payment's tool result.
